summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader without running tests or committing. Changes: new monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and private helpers (_resolve_path, _convert_test_entries); explicit export line in monai/data/__init__.py; "Decathalon DataLoader" subsection with tilde underline after the Utilities automodule in docs/source/data.rst; new tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests, each using TemporaryDirectory). Verified by measurement only: no lines over 120 columns, underline length matches title. Black and flake8 were not run. Choices beyond the spec: top-level JSON must be an object; the value under data_list_key must be a list; malformed JSON propagates as json.JSONDecodeError, which is a ValueError subclass.
